# Exploring Relapse Justifications: Testing

Relapse doesn’t begin with drinking, it begins with thinking. By learning to recognize and challenge [relapse justifications](justification_reading.html) early, you can interrupt the process and protect your recovery.

Use the questions below to help you identify justifications invented by your addicted brain. Identifying and anticipating the justifications will help you interrupt the process.

::: callout
### It’s very easy to forget that being smart, not being strong, is the key to staying abstinent.

Have you ever wanted to prove you could be stronger than alcohol? For example, have you said any of the following?

☐ I’m strong enough to be around it now.\
☐ I want to see whether I can say “No” to drinking and using.\
☐ I want to see whether I can be around my old friends.\
☐ I want to see how drinking feels now that I’ve stopped.\
☐ Other: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

### What might you do when your addicted brain suggests these excuses to use?
:::
